description_en: Queries the backup settings of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的备份设置
name: DescribeBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:
DataBackupPolicy: data backup
LogBackupPolicy: log backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：
DataBackupPolicy：数据备份
LogBackupPolicy：日志备份
parameters.name: backup_policy_mode

parameters.help_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: not compressed
1: zlib compression
2: parallel zlib compression
4: QuickLZ compression with fast restoration for individual databases and tables enabled
8: QuickLZ compression but fast restoration for individual databases and tables not yet supported
parameters.help_zh:
备份压缩方式，取值：
0：不压缩
1：zlib压缩
2：并行zlib压缩
4：quicklz压缩，开启了库表恢复
8：quicklz压缩但还未支持库表恢复
parameters.name: compress_type

parameters.help_en:
The archived backup data retention policy for deleted MySQL instances. Valid values:

None: No archived backups are retained.
Lastest: Only the last archived backup is retained.
All: All archived backups are retained
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。取值：

None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留
parameters.name: released_keep_policy

ArchiveBackupKeepCount.description_en: The number of archived backups retained for the MySQL instance
ArchiveBackupKeepCount.description_zh: MySQL实例归档备份的保留个数

ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy.description_en: The retention cycle of archived backups for the MySQL instance
ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy.description_zh: MySQL实例归档备份的保留周期

ArchiveBackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days for which archived backups are retained for the MySQL instance
ArchiveBackupRetentionPeriod.description_zh: MySQL实例归档备份的保留天数

BackupInterval.description_en:
The backup interval. Unit: minutes.
For MySQL instances, this parameter specifies the [high-frequency snapshot backup frequency]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98818.html） (not the snapshot backup cycle).
For SQL Server instances, this parameter specifies the log backup frequency
BackupInterval.description_zh:
备份间隔，单位：分钟。
对于MySQL实例：指[快照备份频率]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98818.html）（非快照备份周期）。
对于SQL Server实例：指日志备份频率

BackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:
Enable: enabled
Disabled: disabled

For SQL Server instances:

Enable is returned only when instance log backup frequency is every 5 minutes.
When instance log backup frequency is every 30 minutes or consistent with the data backup cycle, this parameter returns Disabled. Use the BackupInterval value as the reference
BackupLog.description_zh:
是否已开启日志备份。返回值：
Enable：是
Disabled：否

对于SQL Server实例：

仅实例日志备份频率为每5 分钟时才返回Enable；
日志备份频率为每30分钟或与数据备份一致时，本参数返回Disabled。请以BackupInterval返回值为准

BackupMethod.description_en:
The backup method for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
Physical: physical backup
Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh:
SQL Server云盘版实例的备份方式。返回值：
Physical：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

BackupPriority.description_en:
The backup settings for the secondary instance of an SQL Server Enterprise Cluster Edition instance. Valid values:
1: Secondary instance preferred.
2: Primary instance forced.

This parameter is returned only when SupportModifyBackupPriority is True
BackupPriority.description_zh:
SQL Server企业集群版实例备库备份的设置。返回值：
1：优先备库
2：强制主库

仅当SupportModifyBackupPriority为True时返回该参数

BackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days for which data backups are retained

Category.description_en:
Indicates whether backup within seconds is enabled for the MySQL or PostgreSQL instance. Valid values:

Flash: Enabled.
Standard: Disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when the BackupPolicyMode parameter is set to DataBackupPolicy
Category.description_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL实例是否已开启秒级备份。返回值：

Flash：开启
Standard：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效

CompressType.description_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: not compressed
1: zlib compression
2: parallel zlib compression
4: QuickLZ compression with fast restoration for individual databases and tables enabled
8: QuickLZ compression but fast restoration for individual databases and tables not yet supported
CompressType.description_zh:
备份压缩方式。返回值：
0：不压缩
1：zlib压缩
2：并行zlib压缩
4：quicklz压缩，开启了库表恢复
8：quicklz压缩但还未支持库表恢复

EnableBackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled.

For SQL Server instances:
1 is returned only when instance log backup frequency is every 5 minutes.
When instance log backup frequency is every 30 minutes or consistent with the data backup cycle, this parameter returns 0. Use the BackupInterval value as the reference
EnableBackupLog.description_zh:
是否开启了日志备份。返回值：
1：开启
0：关闭

对于SQL Server实例：
仅实例日志备份频率为每5 分钟时才返回1。
日志备份频率为每30分钟或与数据备份一致时，本参数返回0。请以BackupInterval返回值为准

EnableIncrementDataBackup.description_en:
Indicates whether incremental backup is enabled for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:
True: Enabled.
False: Disabled
EnableIncrementDataBackup.description_zh:
SQL Server实例是否已开启增量备份。返回值：
True：是
False：否

EnablePitrProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether point-in-time recovery (PITR) is enabled for the MySQL instance. PITR is an upgraded version of log backup. Valid values:
True: Enabled.
False: Disabled.

For more information, see [Configure a point-in-time recovery policy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html）
EnablePitrProtection.description_zh:
MySQL实例是否已开启PITR任意时间点恢复（原日志备份的升级版）。返回值：
True：是
False：否

功能详情，请参见[设置任意时间点恢复策略]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html）

HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_en:
Indicates whether binary logs are forcibly deleted when the storage usage of the MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB. Valid values:

Disable: Binary logs are not forcibly deleted.
Enable: Binary logs are forcibly deleted
HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_zh:
MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否强制清理Binlog。返回值：

Disable：不清理
Enable：清理

LocalLogRetentionHours.description_en: The number of hours for which binary log backups are retained on the MySQL instance
LocalLogRetentionHours.description_zh: MySQL实例本地日志备份保留小时数

LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_en: The maximum storage usage of binary logs on the MySQL instance, in percentage
LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_zh: MySQL实例本地日志最大空间使用率

LogBackupFrequency.description_en:
The log backup frequency for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:

LogInterval: A log backup is performed every 30 minutes.
Default: The log backup frequency is the same as the data backup cycle specified by PreferredBackupPeriod
LogBackupFrequency.description_zh:
SQL Server实例的日志备份频率。返回值：

LogInterval：每30分钟备份一次；
默认与数据备份周期PreferredBackupPeriod一致

LogBackupLocalRetentionNumber.description_en: The number of local binary logs retained on the MySQL instance

LogBackupRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days for which log backups are retained

PitrRetentionPeriod.description_en: The number of days for which point-in-time recovery is supported on the MySQL instance
PitrRetentionPeriod.description_zh: MySQL实例的可任意时间点恢复天数

PreferredBackupPeriod.description_en:
The data backup cycle. Multiple values are separated by commas (,). Valid values:
Monday: Monday
Tuesday: Tuesday
Wednesday: Wednesday
Thursday: Thursday
Friday: Friday
Saturday: Saturday
Sunday: Sunday
PreferredBackupPeriod.description_zh:
数据备份周期，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。返回值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

ReleasedKeepPolicy.description_en:
The archived backup data retention policy for deleted MySQL instances. Valid values:
None: No archived backups are retained.
Lastest: Only the last archived backup is retained.
All: All archived backups are retained
ReleasedKeepPolicy.description_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。返回值：
None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留

SupportModifyBackupPriority.description_en:
Indicates whether the secondary instance backup option can be modified for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:

True: The option can be modified.
False: The option cannot be modified
SupportModifyBackupPriority.description_zh:
SQL Server实例是否支持修改备库备份选项。返回值：

True：是
False：否

SupportVolumeShadowCopy.description_en:
Indicates whether snapshot backup is supported for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:

1: Supported.
0: Not supported
SupportVolumeShadowCopy.description_zh:
SQL Server实例是否支持快照备份。返回值：

1：是
0：否

SupportsHighFrequencyBackup.description_en:
Indicates whether the [5-minute log backup feature]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html） is supported for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:
0: Not supported.
1: Supported
SupportsHighFrequencyBackup.description_zh:
SQL Server实例是否支持[5分钟日志备份功能]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html）。返回值：
0：不支持
1：支持
